title: Home guide: the friction ramp
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Forces, magnets and light (Mighty Metals and Why Do Cat's Eyes Glow at Night?)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 10 (Home practical guide and safety card: friction ramp (portal worksheet))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out how the surface changes how far a car rolls.
equipment: A tray or board and two books (the ramp)
Paper, a towel and a piece of cardboard
safety: Keep the ramp low and steady
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Rest the board on two books to make a ramp.
Let the car roll from the top. Do not push it.
Measure how far it rolls from the bottom of the ramp.
Do it twice on the floor.
Cover the floor at the bottom with paper, then the towel, then the cardboard, and test twice each.
Keep the same ramp and the same car every time: a fair test.
